name: Mageblood
flavourText: Rivers of power coursed through their veins.
Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.

explicitMods: Legacy of Amethyst — Legacy of Amethyst is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to Chaos Resistance.
Legacy of Basalt — Legacy of Basalt is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Armour.
Legacy of Bismuth — Legacy of Bismuth is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to all Elemental Resistances.
Legacy of Diamond — Legacy of Diamond is a Mage's Legacy which grants 75% increased Critical Hit Chance.
Legacy of Gold — Legacy of Gold is a Mage's Legacy which grants 45% increased Rarity of Items found.
Legacy of Granite — Legacy of Granite is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Armour.
Legacy of Jade — Legacy of Jade is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Evasion Rating.
Legacy of Quicksilver — Legacy of Quicksilver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Movement Speed.
Legacy of Ruby — Legacy of Ruby is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Fire Resistance and +5% to Maximum Fire Resistance.

Legacy of Silver — Legacy of Silver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Skill Speed.
Legacy of Stibnite — Legacy of Stibnite is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Evasion Rating.

All Mage's Legacies have (25-50)% increased effect per duplicate Mage's Legacy you have
